items.raw_excerpt: Residents in La Ventanilla used to hunt sea turtles. Now they provide a sanctuary for them, as well as crocodiles.
items.summary_en: People in La Ventanilla, Oaxaca used to hunt sea turtles and crocodiles. Now local families protect the animals and give visitors a place to see them. Tourism money now helps the village run its own wildlife sanctuary.
items.summary_ko: 오악사 주 라벤티야 마을 주민들은 예전에 바다거북과 악어를 사냥했다. 지금은 대신 이 동물들을 지키고 관광객에게 보여준다. 관광 수입이 마을 자체 야생동물 보호소 운영을 돕는다.
items.title_en: Oaxaca Village Turns Tourism Into Wildlife Care

items.title_original: How Oaxaca’s La Ventanilla turned tourism into conservation

items.raw_excerpt: The “Redes na Escola: Dá o Salto!” (School Networks: Take the Leap!) project, developed by InPulsar – Association for Community Development, supported 103 students in Leiria schools during the 2025/26 academic year and achieved an 86.4% success rate.
items.summary_en: A community project in Leiria, Portugal helped103 students at local schools. The program ran during the 2025/26 school year. About 86 out of 100 students finished it successfully.

items.raw_excerpt: Kerala rubber farmers: Residents in 131 villages face livelihood threats as satellite mapping identifies plantations as forests, sparking fierce opposition against the proposed ecologically sensitive area draft notification across the state.
items.summary_en: Rubber farmers in 131 villages in Kerala worry about losing their livelihood. Satellite maps marked their rubber groves as forest land. Many villagers oppose the proposed forest protection rules.

items.raw_excerpt: Parents would enforce Iceland’s proposed social media age limit. The draft sets no special monitoring or penalties and uses a calendar-year threshold.
items.summary_en: Iceland has drafted a plan to set a minimum age for social media use. Parents would be responsible for making sure children follow the rule. The draft has no special monitoring or penalties yet.

items.raw_excerpt: Tucked into the lower, shaded pockets of Parque Eduardo VII, the tranquil pond sitting right outside the pavilion of the Estufa Fria holds one of Lisbon’s most serene outdoor art installations.
items.summary_en: A quiet pond in Lisbon's Parque Eduardo VII holds an outdoor art installation. It sits right outside the Estufa Fria pavilion, in a lower and shaded part of the park. The piece shows a woman in the water, and it is one of the calmest spots in the city.

items.raw_excerpt: The Espinho City Council will boost local civil protection forces with over €250,000 to improve responses to storms, floods, and power outages, the municipality announced.
items.summary_en: The city of Espinho will add more than 250,000 euros to local civil protection teams. The money is for faster help during storms, floods, and power outages.

items.raw_excerpt: Aaron's daughter, Harper, was five years old when she was diagnosed with neuroblastoma.
items.summary_en: A football hit five-year-old Harper in the face. A doctor found a lump in her neck and later learned she had neuroblastoma, a rare cancer. Now Harper is in remission and her family wants other parents to check for lumps early.

items.raw_excerpt: Mexx Meerdink’s first two international goals were enough for the Netherlands to edge past Serbia and earn Xavi Hernandez his first win as coach in a gritty encounter in Belgrade. Meerdink scored from the penalty spot in the first half after Crysencio Summerville was brought down in the area, and slotted the winner midway through the second half in a period when Oranje were dominating. But there was a blow for Xavi ahead when Cody Gakpo had to be replaced...
items.summary_en: Mexico-born forward Meerdink scored two goals for the Netherlands in Belgrade. His goals gave coach Xavi Hernandez his first win. The match was tough, and star forward Gakpo had to leave the field.
